title: Partner/cohort outreach + pilot teaching plan
context: The project's 'delivered' criterion requires the curriculum to be taught to real learners with outcomes recorded. Without a named teaching partner or cohort, all tasks carry verifiedNeed: false. Outreach must begin in M0 — before the pilot module is complete — so a partner can be lined up for the first taught delivery. Candidate channels include cancer-center bioinformatics/training cores, graduate programs, The Carpentries Incubator, ELIXIR bioinformatics training networks, The Turing Way community, and pediatric-sarcoma research consortia. A self-run workshop is an acceptable fallback for M0.
objective: Identify and contact candidate teaching/adoption partners, document a shortlist with rationale and contact approach, draft a pilot teaching plan (format, timing, audience, fallback), and open >= 1 outreach thread with a named candidate.
acceptanceCriteria: >= 1 outreach thread opened with a named candidate partner (bioinformatics core, graduate program, Carpentries, ELIXIR, or equivalent); evidence committed (e.g., reference to email, issue, or public record).
Candidate channel shortlist documented with rationale for each channel and the contact approach used.

Pilot teaching plan drafted: proposed format (workshop or embedded course), session count, estimated audience size and profile, proposed timing, and self-run workshop fallback if no partner is secured before M0 closes.
Document committed to the project repo with DCO sign-off.
If a partner confirms, the GOVERNANCE.md requestor field and relevant task verifiedNeed fields are updated to reflect confirmed status.
resources: PLAN.md (Problem & beneficiaries — Partner org; Governance — Steward role)
output: A PARTNERS.md document committed to the project repo listing the outreach shortlist, contact approach, pilot teaching plan, and evidence of >= 1 outreach thread opened; updated to reflect any confirmed partner commitments.
